title: Sandbox federation participant Git inspection
scope: Prevent participant-controlled Git configuration, ambient credentials, nested repository discovery, and partial-clone lazy fetch from violating the read-only federation boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Federation verifies that each participant path is the exact Git worktree root, disables executable repository Git configuration, uses a scrubbed noninteractive environment, forbids lazy fetch, and fails closed under hostile fixtures.
Focused federation tests, full verification, schema, Doctor, and independent hostile-repository QA pass without network or external side effects.
overlap_resolution: WI-0033 owns provider-trust SECURITY sections; WI-0032 owns federation Git SECURITY sections and Mog joins both.
